candidates: In ASE MD dynamics classes, pressure parameters must be in ASE atomic units (eV/Å³) and named `pressure_au`, following the project convention. Do not introduce pressure parameters with unit-specific suffixes like `pressure_GPa`; callers should convert themselves using `ase.units.GPa` (e.g. `pressure_au=1.0*ase.units.GPa`).

In MD integrators, use `self._num_atoms_global` (set via `self.atoms.get_global_number_of_atoms()`) everywhere an atom count is needed rather than `len(self.atoms)`. Using the local atom count breaks correctness when the integrator is used with domain-decomposition calculators such as Asap.

When initializing a physics parameter array (e.g. chain masses in Nosé-Hoover-like integrators) where element 0 has a different numeric coefficient from the remaining elements, add an inline comment explaining the mathematical basis for each value and citing the relevant equation or section from the reference paper. Without such documentation, a factor-of-N difference between elements looks like a copy-paste error and will draw repeated reviewer scrutiny.
